reasons.text: The label photo's SHA-256 matches a photo already submitted in another claim (17991bfa-eb3c-534d-96c8-4b33bf7984a8), so this claim shares a photo with another claim and must be flagged for review.
The label is legible and shows model 200LX, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.

The serial read from the label (QQ19420553) does not match the typed serial (HA07762). The typed serial is within a recalled range, but the label serial is not in any recalled range, so the serial discrepancy needs reviewer attention.
The purchase date of 2018-06-19 falls inside the sale window (2017-05-01 to 2026-02-28). The retailer is listed as an online marketplace and receipt is not required.
